# Editloft

> Editloft is a free, GPLv2 WordPress plugin: a maintained fork of Edit Flow that works in the block editor. It has exactly three modules plus a settings screen: an editorial calendar, an audit trail and role-based status transitions. It does not include custom post statuses, editorial comments, editorial metadata, notifications or a story budget.

## Features
- [Editorial calendar](https://editloft.com/features/calendar/): drag-and-drop scheduling, unscheduled drafts panel, filters, optional signed iCal feed
- [Audit trail](https://editloft.com/features/audit-trail/): every status change and date move with the person and the path; editor, REST and WP-CLI
- [Status transitions](https://editloft.com/features/status-transitions/): role-based rules for who can submit, schedule, publish and unpublish
- [For developers](https://editloft.com/features/developers/): REST field, WP-CLI command, filters, tests
- [All features](https://editloft.com/features/): the three modules and what is not included

## Guides and comparison
- [Edit Flow alternative](https://editloft.com/compare/edit-flow/): what Editloft and Edit Flow each include
- [How to set up an editorial workflow in WordPress](https://editloft.com/guides/wordpress-editorial-workflow/): five steps using WordPress roles and statuses
- [Benefits by role](https://editloft.com/benefits/): what changes for editors, writers, owners and developers
